title: Purchase Order Age and the Staging Bench on Network and Server Order Cancellations
content:
The build of the infrastructure cancellation fee, the fee on a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, follows the age of the purchase order, counted in calendar days from the order's purchase order date to the day the cancellation is recorded.

- A purchase order at most **1** day old has no units allocated yet, and the fee is built as **40.00 USD** for each unit ordered, with no percentage of the quote total.
- A purchase order at least **7** days old has its units shipped to the staging bench, and the fee is built as the fee percentage of the quote total plus a return freight of **20.00 USD** for each unit ordered.
- A purchase order of any other age builds the fee as the fee percentage of the quote total alone.

| Purchase order age on the cancellation day (calendar days) | Where the units are | Fee built as |
|---|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | not yet allocated | 40.00 for each unit ordered |
| 2 to 6 | allocated, not yet at the bench | the fee percentage of the quote total |
| 7 or more | shipped to the staging bench | the fee percentage of the quote total plus 20.00 for each unit ordered |

### Worked example (hypothetical order of 5 units, quote total 8000.00, fee percentage taken as 15)

- Cancelled 1 day after the purchase order: 5 times 40.00, that is 200.00.
- Cancelled 3 days after: 15 percent of 8000.00, that is 1200.00.
- Cancelled 7 days after: 1200.00 plus 5 times 20.00, that is 1300.00.
